policy.shared_state: one desktop, one primary application instance, one live native project and shared task filesystem

pairs.title: Riverton resilience and evacuation release
pairs.observer_trust_boundary: host records screenshots and read-only instrumentation snapshots; QGIS process integrity is assumed, not adversarially enforced
input_design: 32-48 synthetic parcels with stable IDs and repairable geometry defects
Two DEM sources with declared horizontal CRS, vertical units, NoData and a common vertical datum
Versioned population observations and explicit quality/cutoff rules
Directed road graph, fixed closures, 12 demand origins and capacity-limited shelters
Shared GeoPackage, live project, named role groups and immutable basemap
Public analysis and review policies; no reference answers in inputs
pairs.independence: A reads supplied terrain/population; B reads supplied road closures/demand, never A's risk output. Role layouts and exports are separate. Final group membership is compared by semantic IDs, not insertion order.
concurrency_surfaces: in-memory layer cache versus committed table
export before own transaction is committed
negative_controls: stale B save drops A layer references
stale GeoPackage copy removes the other role's tables
plausible CSV with wrong CRS or NoData treatment
route ignores one-way closure or shelter capacity
export disagrees with its saved native source
static composite impersonates live selection evidence

pairs.title: Articulated enclosure motion and optical identification
input_design: Original multi-part enclosure with inherited transforms, named datums and protected meshes
Editable but incomplete hinge/linkage rig and multi-phase motion brief
Independent calibration chart, material references and packed label atlas
Role B may change UV/material attributes on meshes whose transforms A animates; neither changes topology
Immutable camera definitions and a declared motion envelope
Protected reference assets sharing some initial material datablocks
pairs.independence: Motion changes transforms/rig, finish changes UV/material attributes; meshes and review camera definitions are fixed. Evaluator renders the combined motion only after both stop; B's own contact sheet is a material review, not a promise to include unfinished A motion.
concurrency_surfaces: shared current frame and editor area
negative_controls: stale finish scene deletes completed animation
static endpoint poses without editable motion
mid-frame collision hidden by sparse screenshots
global material edit changes protected assets
fabricated preview unrelated to native project

pairs.title: Parametric clamp and pickup assembly release
input_design: Original incomplete base and pickup Bodies with named immutable mating datums
Dimensioned drawings with linked dimensions, tolerances and public admissible parameter ranges
Shared spreadsheet with reserved Base_* and Pickup_* aliases
Editable sketches/features and independent native TechDraw pages
Protected purchased components and fixed assembly interface envelopes
Separate role exports, no role must wait for the other to finish
pairs.independence: Both Bodies attach to immutable supplied interface datums; neither expression references the other role's mutable parameters. Spreadsheet aliases and pages are disjoint. A→B and B→A must agree semantically across the documented parameter ranges.
concurrency_surfaces: open edit transaction and recompute state
topology references invalidated by careless replacement

static imported solid masquerades as parametric solution
nominal-only model breaks on admissible dimension changes
shape valid but not to drawing
decorative PDF dimensions not linked to native geometry
BOM or STEP comes from an obsolete native revision
